ops.name: relu6
ops.body: float v = arena[ix + inOff]; if (v > float(6.0)) v = float(6.0); if (v < float(0.0)) v = float(0.0); arena[ix + outOff] = v;

ops.name: leakyrelu
ops.body: float v = arena[ix + inOff]; if (v > float(0.0)) arena[ix + outOff] = v; else arena[ix + outOff] = float(alpha) * v;

ops.name: silu
ops.body: float x = arena[ix + inOff]; float s = x / float(1.0 + Math.exp(float(0.0) - x)); arena[ix + outOff] = s;

ops.name: hardswish
ops.body: float x = arena[ix + inOff]; float r = x + float(3.0); if (r < float(0.0)) r = float(0.0); if (r > float(6.0)) r = float(6.0); arena[ix + outOff] = x * r / float(6.0);
